'''GEMP draft and cube products''' are the card pools that [[GEMP]] uses for its draft formats and its Watto's Cube sealed league types. GEMP lists four current draft definitions and three legacy ones.<ref name="drafts">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/resources/swccgDrafts.json swccgDrafts.json], GEMP source code (billbisco/swccg-gemp, commit 16168b26), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021115023/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/billbisco/swccg-gemp/ec48dc19/swccgDrafts.json.html Internet Archive]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022041458/https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/resources/swccgDrafts.json Internet Archive].</ref> For the sealed league products, including the Watto's Cube packs, see [[GEMP sealed league products]].

== How draft picks work ==
Each draft definition names a format code, a starting pool of fixed cards, and a list of choices for each side. Each definition sets 54 picks per side.<ref name="ds2">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/resources/draft/basic_premds2_draft.json basic_premds2_draft.json], GEMP source code (billbisco/swccg-gemp, commit 16168b26), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021125102/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/billbisco/swccg-gemp/ec48dc19/basic_premds2_draft.json.html Internet Archive]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022042031/https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/resources/draft/basic_premds2_draft.json Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="v13">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/resources/draft/basic_premv13_draft.json basic_premv13_draft.json], GEMP source code (billbisco/swccg-gemp, commit 16168b26), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021125236/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/billbisco/swccg-gemp/ec48dc19/basic_premv13_draft.json.html Internet Archive]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022042137/https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/resources/draft/basic_premv13_draft.json Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="v25">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/resources/draft/holocron_premv25_draft.json holocron_premv25_draft.json], GEMP source code (billbisco/swccg-gemp, commit 16168b26), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021125424/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/billbisco/swccg-gemp/ec48dc19/holocron_premv25_draft.json.html Internet Archive]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022042217/https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/resources/draft/holocron_premv25_draft.json Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="c7o">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/resources/draft/cubeObj7Draft.json cubeObj7Draft.json], GEMP source code (billbisco/swccg-gemp, commit 16168b26), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021125332/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/billbisco/swccg-gemp/ec48dc19/cubeObj7Draft.json.html Internet Archive]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022042156/https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/resources/draft/cubeObj7Draft.json Internet Archive].</ref> In all four definitions the Light Side choices come before the Dark Side choices.<ref name="ds2" /><ref name="v13" /><ref name="v25" /><ref name="c7o" />

In a normal pick (<code>cubePackPick</code>), GEMP shuffles that side's list of available cards and offers a number of them. The number offered is the pack size minus the pick number modulo the pack size. Every definition uses a pack size of 9, so the offers run 9, 8, 7 and so on down to 1, then start again at 9. Over 54 picks this repeats six times. A card that is already in the player's pool is not offered again. If the picked card has add-on cards listed, the player gets those cards with it.<ref name="dcb">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/draft2/builder/DraftChoiceBuilder.java DraftChoiceBuilder.java], GEMP source code (billbisco/swccg-gemp, commit 16168b26), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021124147/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/billbisco/swccg-gemp/ec48dc19/DraftChoiceBuilder.java.html Internet Archive]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022041806/https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/draft2/builder/DraftChoiceBuilder.java Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="ds2" />

In an objective pick (<code>cubePackObjPick</code>), each choice is a whole objective pack, shown by its first card. With a pack size of 2, the first objective pick offers two packs and the second offers one. The player gets every card in the chosen pack.<ref name="dcb" /><ref name="c7o" />

== Drafts ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Format !! Code !! Fixed cards !! Objective picks per side !! Cards available to pick (Light / Dark) !! Picks per side
|-
| [[Premiere - Death Star II Draft]] || <code>basic_premds2_draft</code> || 26 (13 per side) || 0 || 360 / 360 || 54<ref name="ds2" />
|-
| [[Premiere - Virtual Set 13 Draft]] || <code>basic_premv13_draft</code> || 20 (10 per side) || 0 || 290 / 290 || 54<ref name="v13" />
|-
| [[Premiere - Virtual Set 25 Draft]] || <code>holocron_premv25_draft</code> || 201 (99 Light Side, 102 Dark Side) || 0 || 300 / 300 || 54<ref name="v25" />
|-
| [[Cube v7 + Objectives Draft]] || <code>c7obj_draft</code> || 0 || 2, from 15 objective packs per side || 262 / 259 || 54<ref name="c7o" />
|}

In the Virtual Set 25 draft, 27 Light Side and 29 Dark Side cards in the pick lists have add-on cards. They bring 28 Light Side and 30 Dark Side add-on cards in all.<ref name="v25" /> In the Cube v7 + Objectives draft, the objective packs have 8 to 25 cards each.<ref name="c7o" />

The draft list also keeps three entries marked legacy: <code>c7_draft</code>, <code>c7revised_draft</code> and <code>cube_worlds_2025_draft</code>.<ref name="drafts" />

== Deck size ==
Each of the four draft definitions names its own format code. In the format list each of these formats, like [[Cube]] and the two Watto's Cube formats, sets a deck size of 40 cards.<ref name="ds2" /><ref name="gemp">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/resources/swccgFormats.json swccgFormats.json], GEMP source code (billbisco/swccg-gemp, commit 16168b26), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021114513/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/billbisco/swccg-gemp/ec48dc19/swccgFormats.json.html Internet Archive]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022040117/https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/resources/swccgFormats.json Internet Archive].</ref>

== Watto's Cube packs ==
The Watto's Cube sealed league types use three pack types:<ref name="wcdp">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/packagedProduct/WattosCubeDraftPack.java WattosCubeDraftPack.java], GEMP source code (billbisco/swccg-gemp, commit 16168b26), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021124727/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/billbisco/swccg-gemp/ec48dc19/WattosCubeDraftPack.java.html Internet Archive]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022041854/https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/packagedProduct/WattosCubeDraftPack.java Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="wcfp">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/packagedProduct/WattosCubeFixedPack.java WattosCubeFixedPack.java], GEMP source code (billbisco/swccg-gemp, commit 16168b26), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021124820/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/billbisco/swccg-gemp/ec48dc19/WattosCubeFixedPack.java.html Internet Archive]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022041927/https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/packagedProduct/WattosCubeFixedPack.java Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="wcop">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/packagedProduct/WattosCubeObjectivePack.java WattosCubeObjectivePack.java], GEMP source code (billbisco/swccg-gemp, commit 16168b26), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021125007/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/billbisco/swccg-gemp/ec48dc19/WattosCubeObjectivePack.java.html Internet Archive]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022042000/https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/16168b26aa0c245d4427f58bbb023338af3cbf6b/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/packagedProduct/WattosCubeObjectivePack.java Internet Archive].</ref>
* '''Watto's Cube Draft Pack''': 9 random cards from a 290-card list for one side.<ref name="wcdp" />
* '''Watto's Cube Fixed Pack''': a fixed set of 10 cards for one side.<ref name="wcfp" />
* '''Watto's Cube Objective Pack''': one objective or other archetype card, chosen at random from 15 for one side, with the related cards the code lists for it.<ref name="wcop" />
The number of each pack in each series is listed at [[GEMP sealed league products]].

== Differences from the Players Committee GEMP ==
The draft files in the Players Committee repository at commit 5e26dd19 have the same starting pools and choices as this code. The only difference in each file is the format code:<ref name="pc-ds2">[https://github.com/PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public/blob/5e26dd19cc700adbf77de53e0d7b89720c94f03e/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/resources/draft/basic_premds2_draft.json basic_premds2_draft.json], GEMP source code (PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public, commit 5e26dd19), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021125853/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public/5e26dd19/basic_premds2_draft.json.html Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="pc-v13">[https://github.com/PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public/blob/5e26dd19cc700adbf77de53e0d7b89720c94f03e/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/resources/draft/basic_premv13_draft.json basic_premv13_draft.json], GEMP source code (PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public, commit 5e26dd19), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021125945/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public/5e26dd19/basic_premv13_draft.json.html Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="pc-v25">[https://github.com/PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public/blob/5e26dd19cc700adbf77de53e0d7b89720c94f03e/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/resources/draft/holocron_premv25_draft.json holocron_premv25_draft.json], GEMP source code (PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public, commit 5e26dd19), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021130132/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public/5e26dd19/holocron_premv25_draft.json.html Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="pc-c7o">[https://github.com/PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public/blob/5e26dd19cc700adbf77de53e0d7b89720c94f03e/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/resources/draft/cubeObj7Draft.json cubeObj7Draft.json], GEMP source code (PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public, commit 5e26dd19), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021130038/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public/5e26dd19/cubeObj7Draft.json.html Internet Archive].</ref>
* '''Format code''': each Players Committee draft file names the format <code>cube</code>. Each file in this code names its own format (<code>basic_premds2_draft</code>, <code>basic_premv13_draft</code>, <code>holocron_premv25_draft</code>, <code>c7obj_draft</code>).<ref name="ds2" /><ref name="v13" /><ref name="v25" /><ref name="c7o" />
* '''Deck size''': the Players Committee format list sets the <code>cube</code> format to 45 cards and has no separate draft formats. This code sets Cube, the two Watto's Cube formats and the four draft formats to 40 cards.<ref name="pc-gemp">[https://github.com/PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public/blob/5e26dd19cc700adbf77de53e0d7b89720c94f03e/src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/resources/swccgFormats.json swccgFormats.json], GEMP source code (PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public, commit 5e26dd19), GitHub. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021130403/https://swccg.com/snapshots/github/PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public/5e26dd19/swccgFormats.json.html Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="gemp" />
